businesses.business: smart metering and grid edge intelligence for utilities

offering_description.value: Makes smart electricity, gas and water meters, communication networks, and software and analytics for utilities and cities. Sells hardware, software and managed services to utilities that measure, manage and optimize energy and water use. Products are designed in-house and built in own and contract factories.

primary_products.value: smart electricity meters; gas and water meters and endpoints; network communication devices; grid edge sensors and controls

primary_services.value: managed services; software as a service; analytics and grid optimization; deployment and implementation support; maintenance and support

customer_segment.value: B2B: investor-owned and cooperative electric, gas and water utilities, commercial and industrial customers; B2G: municipal utilities and city governments

end_markets.value: electric utilities; gas utilities; water utilities; smart cities

revenue_model.value: product sales: meters, endpoints and network devices; subscription: software and cloud-hosted solutions; service fees: managed services, maintenance and support; project or contract: multi-year utility deployment contracts
revenue_model.category: product sales; subscription; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds meters and network devices from purchased components, sold to utilities; software / platform: grid analytics and network management software for utilities; service provider: managed services and deployment support for utilities
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia Pacific and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: meters, networks, software and managed services for utility measurement and grid management

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to utilities and cities; partners / resellers: channel partners and distributors for smaller utilities and regions

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: metering accuracy standards, radio spectrum rules (FCC), cybersecurity and utility regulator requirements
